arguments.code:
import re
sn_access = apis.simple_note.login(username='gl.moore@gmail.com', password='aVfy)Rr')['access_token']
note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=1556, access_token=sn_access)
content = note['content']
print('note title:', note['title'])
print('content preview:\n', content[:500])

lines = content.splitlines()
current_title=None
titles=[]
for line in lines:
    line=line.strip()
    if not line:
        continue
    if line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    if line.startswith('- director:') or line.startswith(' - director:'):
        # not expected
        pass
    # Title lines are those that don't start with '-' and don't contain ':'
    # but titles can contain ':' (e.g., The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers) so we instead rely on bullet marker
    if not line.startswith('-') and not line.lower().startswith('director') and not line.lower().startswith('genre'):
        # title candidate
        current_title=line
        continue
    if line.startswith('- director:'):
        director=line[len('- director:'):].strip()
        if director=='Quentin Tarantino' and current_title:
            titles.append(current_title)

# Deduplicate while preserving order
seen=set(); dedup=[]
for t in titles:
    if t not in seen:
        seen.add(t); dedup.append(t)

print('Tarantino titles:', dedup)
print('Comma-separated:', ', '.join(dedup))
